correctness.rationale: Each prefix-reduced-column subset exactly spans the persistent chain space, since deleting early boundary rows preserves independence of distinct remaining low pivots. For each fixed terminal t, cumulative Gram–Schmidt vectors span the nested spaces in s, and their boundary outer products yield the exact persistent up-Laplacian. Summing \(O(m k_t^2+(nm+n^2)k_t)\) over ≤m t-rows gives \(O(m^4+nm^3+n^2m^2)\), including the reduced-column construction. Exact rational checker tests 969 grid events and every filtration pair in 120 seeded face-closed examples; finite checks do not replace the proof.
